name: Vila do Bispo
mandate: PrompTugal.news Vila do Bispo: AI and technology in Vila do Bispo, from Sagres and Cape St Vincent to the sea and the wind, and what reaches Vila do Bispo from the Algarve, Portugal and the world. Independent; every fact sourced.

gravity.text: On the sources we could open, the municipality's technology story is the sea and the wind. Sagres hosts a marine biotechnology company at Porto da Baleeira, a university marine laboratory in the same port, and the MARREAL underwater observatory, a camera and sensor station at 20 metres depth that records ocean data in real time. The INEGI and APREN wind farm inventory lists wind farms in the municipality, including 2025 repowering. We found no AI news, which is the first finding of this page, but the ocean data stations are where an AI path is most likely to appear.

ai_map.name: Municipio de Vila do Bispo, digitalisation of municipal services
ai_map.what: The council's own project sheet (approved 9 October 2025, running 1 July 2022 to 31 December 2027): strengthen the technology and network infrastructure for more capacity and reliability, described as technological modernisation and digital transformation of local administration. Eligible cost 1,072,637.94 euros, EU support 643,582.75 euros.
ai_map.ai_path: Not AI itself. A council's digital backbone is what any later AI service for residents would run on. Path: municipal network and digital services, then AI services on top. No AI use is stated.

ai_map.name: Municipio de Vila do Bispo, smart urban waste management
ai_map.what: The council's project sheet (approved 21 November 2025, 1 June 2024 to 31 December 2025): reinforce and optimise separate waste collection, with efficiency, 'intelligent' waste management and bio-waste collection. Eligible cost 439,725 euros, EU support 263,835 euros.
ai_map.ai_path: Weak. The sheet says intelligent management but does not mention AI or sensors. Path: smart waste collection, then data-driven routing, then AI. Unconfirmed.

ai_map.name: MARREAL underwater observatory, Sagres (UAlg, CINTAL, CCMAR, INESC-TEC)
ai_map.what: An observatory installed in October 2022 at about 20 metres depth off Sagres, with an underwater video camera, a temperature and salinity sensor, a particle sensor and an underwater noise sensor. It records data in real time, to be put online. An initiative of the Tec4Sea research infrastructure, with the KTTSeaDrones project joining.
ai_map.ai_path: Video and acoustic data streams are the raw material for automatic detection of fish and sounds. The article itself does not mention AI, so the link is unconfirmed. Path: ocean observatory, then its video and sound data, then AI analysis.

ai_map.name: KTTSeaDrones (cross-border Spain and Portugal project, with a Sagres pilot)
ai_map.what: A POCTEP research project on aerial and aquatic drones and fixed sensors for marine and fisheries science, led by the Universidad de Huelva, with CCMAR and CINTAL as Algarve partners and a pilot at Sagres. A search result describing its technical report says its software layer used computer vision and AI to detect fish. We could not open the report (it returned errors), so the AI claim is unverified.
ai_map.ai_path: Reported by a search summary of the project's technical report: computer vision and AI models to identify fish in video. To be confirmed by opening the report. Path: marine monitoring project, then its fish detection software, which is AI.

ai_map.name: Sea4Us
ai_map.what: Marine biotechnology company in Sagres that develops drugs from marine compounds, led by a chronic pain candidate called Sea4Pain. Spin-off of Nova Medical School, working from Porto da Baleeira.
ai_map.ai_path: Candidate only. Drug discovery is a field where AI is widely used, but neither source we opened says Sea4Us uses AI. Path: marine biotech, then computational drug discovery, then AI. Unconfirmed, to check with the company's own pages.

ai_map.name: Universidade do Algarve and CCMAR, Sagres marine biology laboratory
ai_map.what: A teaching and research laboratory at Porto da Baleeira, planned with the municipality and funded by the Fosteam@South project, about 2.1 million euros of Recovery and Resilience money, as reported in June 2023. The Universidade do Algarve's page shows the Sagres Marine Station hosted the Sagres Marine Science Festival from 6 to 9 May 2026, with the municipality as co-organiser.
ai_map.ai_path: Candidate only. The article describes reef mapping and sampling, not AI. Path: marine research, then ocean data and mapping, then AI analysis. Unconfirmed.

extras.label: Wind farms listed in the municipality (INEGI and APREN inventory)
extras.value: Vila do Bispo I, 4 turbines of 500 kW, 2.0 MW, from 1998. Vila do Bispo II repowering, 3 turbines of 4.2 MW (Enercon E-115 EP3), 12.6 MW, listed as 2025. A Picos Verdes repowering of 1 turbine of 2.1 MW is also listed. The document's tables mix capacity and repowering rows, so check against operators before quoting.

gaps: No AI news found for Vila do Bispo. Searches in Portuguese and English for AI, startups, data centres and digital projects returned tourism, heritage and council news only. That is a finding, not a missing page.

The council's news page loads with curl (the fetch tool fails on it). On 16 November its recent items were the storm Charles response, an ultra trail finish, a cliff rescue training exercise, wildfire prevention notices and gift cards for students: no AI item. A press search suggested a 421 thousand euro council data centre, but the funded projects page we read lists digitalisation and smart waste, not a data centre, so it stays unconfirmed.
Wind power appears in the INEGI and APREN inventory (see extras), but we found no AI link for it and have not opened the operators' own pages.
No events found. Sources to look for: council agenda, Universidade do Algarve events at Sagres, Algarve Evolution.
No local feeds found. Sources to look for: an RSS feed from Barlavento or the council.

Sea4Us, the marine laboratory and MARREAL are on the map as candidates with an unconfirmed AI path, and KTTSeaDrones's AI claim rests on a search summary of a report we could not open (a certificate error on the host). Their own pages must say whether AI is used.
No MARREAL data page or later news found: the 2022 article promised the data online 'soon', and we did not find it.
No Algarve Evolution link to Vila do Bispo found in a search on 16 November. Sea4Us shows no 2026 news and no AI work in the sources we reached.

Starting a company here: only one route found so far (Vicentina's funding calls, from a 2020 article). We found no incubator in the municipality. Next: the council's business pages, Algarve regional incubation vouchers, and the Monchique incubator next door.
A search suggested a municipal entrepreneur support office run with Vicentina, but the only source returned 403, so it is not listed. The council's contacts page shows no business desk.

voice.lede: Aqui no fim do mundo, o vento e que manda e a IA ainda esta a chegar de bicicleta.
voice.mandate: PrompTugal.news Vila do Bispo: the AI and technology news from the very edge of Europe, where the Atlantic blows past Sagres and Cape St Vincent. Independent, and every fact has a source, pa.
voice.gravity: Pa, our sources show the sea doing the heavy lifting. A marine biotech company sits at Porto da Baleeira and the university has a marine laboratory in the same port. Wind is part of life here too, but we have no source to cite yet. AI news? We found none, and we are telling you straight.
voice.gaps_intro: What we did not find, dito com franqueza:

start_company.name: Vicentina, development association of the southwest (LEADER local action group, Adere programmes)
start_company.what: Regional development association whose funding calls have covered Vila do Bispo with Aljezur and Monchique. A 2020 call, +CO3SO Emprego Interior, funded job creation including self-employment in micro and small firms in low-density areas, 2.0 million euros across three measures. The call is old, so check what is open now.
